title: 执行者交回一步的东西

kind.description: patch: the full set of nodes and edges for this step. covered: the step's existing nodes on the canvas still hold; omit nodes and edges.

name.description: Node name shown on the canvas and used as an edge endpoint. Unique across the canvas. When rebuilding a step, reuse the existing names so downstream edges stay attached.

type.description: Node type exactly as returned by describe_node, e.g. n8n-nodes-base.postgres

params.description: Parameters keyed by the names describe_node returned. Set the operation parameter when the node has one. Reference upstream data with n8n expressions, e.g. ={{ $json.fileName }}. A blank is left empty here and named in blanks.

blanks.description: Parameters left for the user to fill, plus required credential names (e.g. "postgres"). Empty when nothing is left open.

to.description: Target node name; at least one end is a node of this step

output.description: Only when the source node has several outputs: If -> "true" or "false"; Loop Over Items -> "done" or "loop". Omit otherwise.
